home.title: Got a letter from HMRC? Understand it. Sort it.
home.intro: Upload a photo or PDF. We explain it in plain English or Romanian, show your deadlines, and help you appeal a penalty if you had a good reason.

home.how_2: Got a penalty? Answer a few questions. We tell you honestly whether HMRC is likely to accept your reason.
home.how_3: If you can appeal, get the official form filled in, in English, ready to sign and send.
home.o1_text: Plain-language explanation, key dates and next steps.
home.o2_text: Appeal form filled in from your answers and emailed to you. You sign and post it.
home.o3_text: A qualified accountant checks and improves your appeal within 48 hours.
home.pay_note: You only pay once we've checked an appeal is possible.

fu.intro: Thank you, we have your documents. Our accountant will need a few details from you to prepare the company's appeal. Choose how you'd like us to contact you.
fu.when: When can we call you? Tick every time that suits you.
fu.call_note: We'll email you to confirm the call time.
fu.email_note: We'll email you with any questions, usually within one working day.
fu.err_slots: Please tick at least one time.
fu.err_server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
fu.done_phone: We'll email you to confirm a call time from the ones you chose.
fu.done_email: We'll be in touch by email shortly.
fu.code_note: We've also emailed you about the authorisation code HMRC will post to the company.
fu.intro_appt: Thank you for booking. Tick the days and times that suit you and we'll confirm the appointment.

auth.scope_short: This covers only this penalty appeal. Any other work needs a separate agreement.

code.title: Send us the HMRC authorisation code
code.intro: HMRC has posted a letter to the company with an authorisation code. It lets us act for the company's Corporation Tax. Type the code exactly as it appears in the letter.
code.label: Authorisation code
code.hint: Letters and numbers only. The code is only valid for a limited time, so please send it as soon as the letter arrives.
code.err_code: Please check the code. It should be 4 to 20 letters and numbers.
code.done_title: Thank you, we have the code
code.done_text: Our accountant will use it to finish the authorisation with HMRC. We'll be in touch about the appeal.

pkg.title: Your instant estimate
pkg.intro: Answer a few questions and see the price straight away. Your penalty appeal is included free.
pkg.dormant: Was the company dormant (no trading at all)?
pkg.years: How many year-ends are overdue (annual accounts and Corporation Tax return not filed)?
pkg.software: Which software are the books kept in?
pkg.tx: Roughly how many bank transactions in total (all overdue years)?
pkg.tx_hint: Count the lines on the business bank statements. A rough number is fine.
pkg.payroll: Is the company registered for payroll (PAYE)?
pkg.employees: Number of employees (including directors on payroll)
pkg.cis: Is the company registered for CIS as a contractor (paying subcontractors)?
pkg.months_cis: Months of CIS returns not submitted
pkg.vat: Is the company registered for VAT?
pkg.months_vat: Months of VAT not submitted (a quarter = 3 months)
pkg.directors: How many directors does the company have?
pkg.sa: Are the directors' personal tax returns (Self Assessment) up to date?
pkg.sa_missing: How many directors' tax returns are missing in total? (for example 2 directors × 2 years = 4)
pkg.cs: Is the confirmation statement due as well?
pkg.total: To bring the company up to date: {amount}
pkg.l_yearend: Annual accounts and Corporation Tax return: {n} × {each} = {amount}
pkg.disclaimer: This is an estimate based on your answers. We confirm the final price once we've seen your records. No VAT is added.
pkg.future: Would you like us to look after the company from now on?
pkg.year_end: The company's year-end (end of the accounting period)
pkg.year_end_hint: It's on the penalty letter or on Companies House. Any past year-end date is fine.
pkg.sa_future: Include the directors' personal tax returns
pkg.m_need_ye: Enter the company's year-end to see the monthly price.
pkg.m_total: Then from now on: {amount} a month for {months} months
pkg.m_annual: Next year's accounts, tax return, confirmation statement and the other yearly items: {amount} ÷ {months} months = {each}
pkg.m_until: Until the next year-end on {date}. We'll then agree the following year with you.
